sm7150.note: Snapdragon 730/730G family. No TARGET_PLATFORM line in target/m51/config.sh or target/a71/config.sh, and no platform/sm7150/ directory in any repo — the family identity is carried by the DVFS/SSRM filenames (dvfs_policy_sm7150_xx, siop_m51_sm7150). note: The universal porter's SoC-family manifest. The build workflow does NOT hard-code which upstream fork/branch to use for a device: scripts/resolve-device.py reads the device's JSON, finds its SoC family here, and the workflow builds from that family's primary upstream. A family is 'mapped' only when its primary upstream was read from the real repos; 'listed' families have their codename-to-family mapping verified from the target/ table in research/02-targets-sm7150.md, but their family defaults have not been used in a build yet. Do not invent firmware strings: where a family's source firmware was not read, it is null with a note saying where to read it from.
